## What lands

- **The release's spatial index (the "R-tree in the per-release SQLite")** — `exports/search_index_v2.py`: `site_points` R*Tree (`id=record_seq`, one degenerate box per published point at the published precision) + `lat`/`lon`/`point_precision` columns on the per-compartment `sig.release-search-index/2` record index; `exports/release.py` feeds it exactly the coordinates `record_from_site_row` publishes (coords + `point_status == "resolved"` — never a withheld pair).
- **The two routes (dark-shipped)** — `api/release_bbox.py` + `api/app.py`:
  `GET /v1/releases/{pub or latest}/compartments/{comp}/sites?bbox=&page=` (per-compartment JSON `sig.sites-bbox/1`, ≤ 100 rows/page, derived labels) and `GET /v1/releases/{pub or latest}/sites` (cross-compartment grouped JSON; `format=html` / browser Accept → the zero-JS grouped page `exports/site_list_page.py` with per-group licence lines — the map's "Show all N in this area" target). Serving mirrors the v2 search contract: `latest` via the conf-gen pointer, streaming verify-and-copy, bounded verified set, the access-time withdrawal barrier with scope-count denials (DR-C4-09), antimeridian bbox splits, 2 s query budget, immutable/mutable cache headers, no query logging (SIG-SRCH-012).
- **The staged roll (queued, never run)** — `ops/gcp/bbox-api-roll.sh` (check/apply/verify; window guard + `SIG_BBOX_AUTHOR` verbatim-go env) + `docs/build/reports/p37.20-bbox-api-roll/` packet + DEFERRALS `D-P37.20-1` + `obligation-event/1` anchor + `return_pass.toml` rows. The deploy flip (`SIG_API_BBOX=on` + `memory 1Gi` per D-K3-5 [B-30] = yes) is the operator's explicit verbatim go only — never pre-authorised under OM-20.
